A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same STIV research. All 46 pages in each version, including Appendices A–K, provide readable text, equations, tables and figures supporting a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original generation benchmarks, architecture and training ablations, human evaluations in Figure 13, and UCF-101 experiments in Appendix H.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including VBench and VBench-I2V comparisons, human evaluations and appendix experiments.

M1.justification: The STIV architecture, frame replacement, image-condition dropout, JIT-CFG, training objectives, progressive training and application-specific procedures remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation coverage is identical, including image/video generation, video prediction, interpolation, multi-view generation, long-video generation and Appendix H's UCF-101 class-to-video task. No datasets or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the main and appendix experiments, including Tables 9–12, Zero123++ in Figure 10c, and the UCF-101 baselines in Table 17.

E3.justification: Both versions specify the same training budgets, model sizes, resolutions, frame counts, metrics and evaluation procedures. The controlled initialization comparisons and application-specific settings also remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The architecture, initialization, guidance and data-engine ablations are identical. Appendix human evaluations, image-dropout visual comparisons and UCF-101 ablations are also retained without additions or revisions.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Appendix D retains five raters per image pair and the same voting procedure; neither version adds run counts, seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative examples match throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 9 retains 83.1 for M-512 SFT + TUP, and Table 10 retains 90.1 for STIV-M-512; appendix result entries are likewise unchanged.

T1.justification: The flow-matching objective, guidance equations, Appendix A's probability-mass derivation and renormalization formula, and Appendix I's DSG-Video definitions are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about unified T2V/TI2V generation, scalability, benchmark performance and flexible downstream applications.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including the image-dropout explanation, VBench-I2V's preference for low-motion videos, long-video training limitations and the temporal-attention qualification in Appendix J.3.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware discussion, compute accounting, preprocessing instructions and resource links are retained. The updated arXiv self-link does not change access to implementation or data resources.

R1.justification: Section 6, the 76 references and the positioning relative to previous video-generation methods are unchanged. The contributor-credit edit does not revise research positioning.

P1.justification: Yifan Jiang is removed from the author list and added to Section 8's acknowledgements. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Scientific wording, section order and appendix organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The shortened author row is re-spaced, and the expanded acknowledgement wraps onto an additional line. Figures, tables, captions and their placement remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices.

improvement.justification: v2 revises contributor credit and version marking, with small accompanying layout adjustments. The scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations and reproducibility information are unchanged across the main text and appendices, leaving overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
